plugins.description: Runs a math class: a real question-authoring UI (multiple choice, free response, multi-select, matching-pair with distractors), adaptive per-student difficulty (off by default; teacher-toggleable automatic/manual, asymmetric -- 3-in-a-row correct to move up a tier, 2-in-a-row wrong to move down), a correctness streak and opt-in scoreboard per student, live mid-session editing via a teacher_command control attribute, a per-class identity (class_code/class_name) so more than one class can run on the same machine without their data mixing, and persistence -- a class's identity, roster, and question bank survive the process exiting, and can be resumed later. Install math-student alongside it, or have a real student join by code from their own device, to see the tally move.
plugins.author: prackoreal

plugins.description: One simulated student in a math-teacher class, for same-machine testing: watches its assigned question (tiered if the teacher's adaptive difficulty is on) and answers after a short random 'thinking' delay. A REAL student doesn't install this -- they join a live class by code from math-teacher's own UI, which answers all four question types (multiple choice, free response, multi-select, matching-pair by click or drag-and-drop) for real. Install several instances of this bot to populate math-teacher's live tally for testing without real students.
plugins.author: prackoreal

plugins.description: A 2D/3D graphing calculator, Desmos/GeoGebra-style. Plot one or more functions (pan/zoom) or a 3D surface (orbit/zoom) by writing plain math expressions to its "graphs" attribute -- usable standalone, or driven by another plugin over Core the same way city-routing feeds city-residents a route.
plugins.author: prackoreal

packages.name: Math Plugin
packages.description: A teacher runs a real math class (multiple choice, free response, multi-select, matching-pair with distractors, adaptive difficulty, streaks, an opt-in scoreboard, live mid-session editing, per-class identity, persistence across restarts) and a real student joins by code from their own device to answer live. The math-student testing bot and the 2D/3D graphing calculator are both separate, optional plugins -- install them individually if you want them; they no longer come bundled in by default.
